## Software `mtd`: Modeling Workflow

1. Load Dependencies & Package

2. Data Preparation

3. Model Configuration

4. Model Fitting

5. MCMC Convergence Diagnostics 

6. Prediction & Evaluation

## Software `mtd`: Code Snippet [^demo]

```r
# 1. Load dependencies & package
library(tidyverse)                                      # <1>
library(devtools)                                       # <1>
devtools::load_all()                                    # <1>

# 2. Prepare data
data <- readRDS("MWH.rds")                              # <2>
test_start <- 7029
train_dat <- data$WHuv50[1:(test_start - 1)]            # <2>

# 3. Configure model
mtdorder <- 5                                           # <3>
mcmc_param <- list(niter = 85000, nburn = 5000, nthin = 20) # <3>
# prior, starting values, tuning parameters              # <3>

# 4. Fit model
set.seed(42)                                            # <4>
runtime <- system.time(                                 # <4>
  res <- tsMTD(                                         # <4>
    obs = train_dat,                                    # <4>
    mtdorder = mtdorder,                                # <4>
    family = "gamma", # Gamma marginal # <4>
    cop_family = 1,   # Gaussian copula # <4>
    weight = "cdp",   # CDP weights # <4>
    prior = prior, starting = starting, tuning = tuning,# <4>
    mcmc_param = mcmc_param                             # <4>
  )                                                    # <4>
)                                                      # <4>

# Fitting on HPC; Return results & runtime for local analysis 
saveRDS(res, "res_wind_chain1.RData")       
saveRDS(runtime, "runtime_wind_chain1.RData") 

# 5. Validate
# Four chains; Product trace, density, ACF plots & Gelman–Rubin diagnostics via package coda # <5>

# 6. Predict & Evaluate
res <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "res_wind_chain1.RData")) 
test_dat <- data$WHuv50[(7029 - mtdorder):length(data$WHuv50)] 
lags <- lagmat(test_dat, mtdorder) 

set.seed(42)                                             # <6>
res_pred <- predMTD(                                     # <6>
  res = res, # <6>
  family = "gamma", # Gamma marginal # <6>
  lags = lags,  # <6>
  probs = c(0.025, 0.975) # <6>
) # <6>
 
obs <- test_dat[-(1:mtdorder)] 

pred <- data.frame(
  obs = obs,
  q025 = res_pred[1, ],
  q975 = res_pred[2, ]
)

covered <- pred$obs >= pred$q025 & pred$obs <= pred$q975    
coverage <- mean(covered)  
```

1. **Initialize:** Load dependencies & package
2. **Prepare:** Load data
3. **Configure:** Specify the MTD order, MCMC settings, priors, starting values, and sampler tuning
4. **Fit:** Run MTD model with reproducibility and runtime tracking
5. **Validate:** Assess four MCMC chains locally using coda
6. **Predict & Evaluate:** Generate 95% predictive intervals and calculate empirical coverage 

[^demo]: 5. & 6.: Simplified here for demonstration; Implemented as reusable functions in the workflow.
